nodes.text: For the subletting route, a landlord-and-tenant relationship must exist between the tenant and sub-tenant, with the incidents of letting or tenancy identified in the supplied interpretation.

nodes.text: For the assignment route, the tenant must divest himself of all rights held as a tenant.

source_refs.quote: In assignment the tenant has to divest himself of all the rights that he has as a tenant.

nodes.text: For the parting-with-possession route, the tenant must give or vest possession in another person by divesting or abandoning the tenant's own right to possession.
